question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Callous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Merciful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Callous"** means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (क्रूर, कठोर)

 
 
• **Example:** His callous attitude towards the suffering of others was shocking.
 
 
 
• **"Merciful"** refers to showing or exercising mercy; being compassionate and forgiving, which is the opposite of being callous. (दयालु, क्षमाशील)
 
 
• **Example:** The judge was merciful and gave the offender a second chance.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Callous'** is **'Merciful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Merciful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apathetic** (उदासीन): Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

 
 
• **Example:** She seemed apathetic towards the plight of the homeless.
 
 
 
• **Insensitive** (असंवेदनशील): Showing or feeling no concern for the feelings of others.
 
 
• **Example:** His insensitive comments hurt everyone's feelings.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors.
 
 
• **Example:** The careless driver caused a serious accident.
